reviews.text: Our dog loves coming here and I trust them to take great care of her. They’re super nice!

It was good until it wasn't. My baby has gone through two different groomers. Now we are on the third. That person was sweet, but his skills are not there. The customer service is also lacking. A simple sorry is not always sufficient. I won't be back.
Woof gang is the best! I take both my pups here for years!
Zoe groomed my dog Banksy who suffers from high anxiety. Great haircut, fast service & very welcoming! We will be back. Awesome staff all around!
Woofgang is always so great to my pups they are always naturally nervous upon arrival but the staff treats them with care and they come out looking great 😊
Sooooo cute in here! The cookies looked good enough to eat. Had to remind myself they are for dogs!!
I love coming here for Roo , they are so kind and always have my baby looking good and fresh ! We love Brandon and the front desk team .
They took such good care of my pup on her first trip to the groomers. Definitely going back to have my sweet Zara see Brandon!
Great service! Brandon did an awesome job with Koda and Bear. The boys look great and are acting like they feel great too. 😂 Thanks again! …
The staff is super friendly and helpful with questions! The dogs looked fantastic once they were done and they loved the treats.

Woof Gang Bakery did an amazing job with both of my girls! They came home looking absolutely adorable with fresh, clean cuts and the cutest bandanas. You can tell the staff genuinely cares about the dogs they work with—they were patient, kind, and took great care of both of my pups.

The salon was clean, professional, and the grooming was exactly what I was hoping for. My girls looked happy, smelled amazing, and their coats were soft and beautifully trimmed. It’s such a relief finding a groomer you can trust with your dogs. We’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend Woof Gang Bakery to anyone looking for quality grooming and wonderful customer service!
Great customer service and very informative! Looking forward to bringing Ace & Ellie to their first grooming appointment!
amazing environment for fur babies.great service and help from gabriella.

Wood Gang is an amazing pet store! They have a great selection of toys, treats, and goodies for every occasion, whether you’re celebrating a birthday, holiday, or just want to spoil your furry friend. The store is always clean, well-stocked, and it’s easy to find something special.

The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about pets. If you’re looking for quality pet products or grooming in San Antonio, I highly recommend stopping by Wood Gang. My pets always leave happy, and so do I!
Amazing staff, have gotten both my fur babies groomed here and they always look amazing!!
First time coming here and the staff was really nice and sweet
Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star rating!
Woof Gang at the Pearl is the best!
Woof gang is a wonderful pet store, bakery, and groomer. The staff is friendly and they take great care of the animals during grooming. My pup Charlie and I are big fans!
Andrea is the best super helpful
My pup always has a great experience! The staff is so friendly and helpful!
Such a friendly staff… amazing prices… we went for the treats and pup cup filling..
Amazing experience! Forgot my leashes and they were so helpful for finding me some at a decent price! Thank you Gabriela and Sandra!!
They have cut my dogs hair multiple times and each time she looked so refreshed and beautiful. They are very sweet to the doggies and have amazing treats for sale.
JJ is phenomenal. Highly recommend. He does my puppy as well as my parents.
Loved how my little puppy came out. They did such a great job cutting her hair!
Great service with grooming and fantastic treats!
Great people, great service!
Great place amazing staff and just so many items for our dog

I love this place!!They always do a great job with  my dog Milo.Brandon was our groomer this time.We usually have Zoey but she does not work Mondays, so we decided to make an appointment with another groomer.They paired Milo up with Brandon and he did a fabulous job.I will not go to any other place as this place is perfect for me and my dog.They give your dog a bag of treats after their grooming.Thanks again Brandon for a amazing job.

Excellent Experience at Woof Gang Bakery!

My wife and I recently visited with our puppy, Max, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience. The bakery has a wonderful selection, and we found some fantastic treats that Max absolutely loves!

A special shout-out to Allie, who was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout our visit. Exceptional customer service like hers makes all the difference. We will definitely be back for more treats soon! Highly recommend to all pet parents.

“Cheryl is an amazing groomer, and Andrea at the front desk is incredibly knowledgeable and welcoming. The place is always very clean, and they have a great selection of dog treats and grooming supplies. Highly recommend!”

Gabriela assisted us- was helped within seconds of walking in, she even delayed her coffee intake to help us and THAT is customer service! She clearly puts clients needs first. Helpful and sincere, the groomer who assisted us (unfortunately didn’t get her name)… nail trim was wonderful and took care of our baby. 10/10 would recommend <3
Thank you so much for your kind 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to hear that your experience was a positive one.

We had the best time visiting Woof Gang Bakery and Grooming on Broadway! The receptionist is the absolute nicest and made my Lexa and I feel so welcomed! We got some yummy treats to take home! Lexa said we absolutely need to come back for more treats!!

Dog still smells and told me both pups were ready when only one was ready. They want me to come back in 30 min to get the other pup. They got me driving back and fourth because they can’t communicate correctly. And want me to pay full price for my dog that still smells.  👎🏻

I love this place the staff is continuously providing great care and love towards my fur aby Mollie never disappointed if there is something that I'm not happy with they listen and come to a resolution immediately. Love this place thank you for all the ❤️❤️❤️❤️💖💖💖🙏🙏🙏🙏

I took my Australian shepherd here for a grooming service. I booked a full service groom online. When I dropped my dog off the groomer asked what I wanted and I said an overall trim. When I picked up my dog her entire belly area was shaved. Her pants were cut with the clippers down to her undercoat. Double coated dogs shouldn't be shaved. My dog has been licking and scratching her belly all day. I have never had a groomer use clippers on my dog. They did not trim behind her ears or collar at all. Before leaving this review I called and asked to speak to a supervisor. I was only able to speak to an employee who said she spoke to her Supervisor. I was told it is standard practice to shave the belly of a shepherd. It is not. Poor customer service. Poor groom by an inexperienced groomer. All at the tune of almost $100. They offered me a free bath next time. But there will not be a next time.
Bella was a happy girl after her grooming appointment, which tells me she had a great experience! I am a a full time customer now. Everyone is so nice! And the shop area is wonderful
Love taking my Cassie there. Very friendly staff and very welcoming staff.

First time with wood gang and me and my dog just left super happy! Reception and groomer first impression was so fantastic , i love how the groomer came out and spoke with us directly so we know who was cutting his hair. , they were transparent and clearly knowledgeable! they fixed my dog up exactly how i asked! the price is AMAZING  for the attention to detail and care they clearly put in!   we definitely just found our new groomer!
Recently changed groomers and this is a great place. Nice and clean and they have a full variety of baked goodies for your pups!!!! Staff is friendly.
Great service, they treated my dogs very well.

Sabrina did an amazing job grooming Duke yesterday! He came home looking so cute, clean, and happy. Duke is usually very hesitant about baths, but he walked in with no problem. Sabrina was incredibly sweet and patient with him, which made the whole experience so much better. This was his second time getting groomed here, and we will definitely be back!

Customer service was so-so. Called in to make an appointment and was left on hold for 15 minutes, I ended up hanging up. Made an appointment online and had some issues on the mobile site inputting date of birth. Was eventually able to make an appointment on my Ipad.

Went to the appointment and was informed that my pup needed a rabies shot to be seen (which is understandable) but it wasn’t mentioned anywhere on the site itself what shots the dogs should have before being seen, only that shots/vaccines must be up to date. I had sent the records I had that they wanted but there wasn't any contact to me regarding the missing shots needed which ended up with my time being wasted in getting there.
Thank you for your wonderful 5-star rating! 🐾🩷 …
Thank you for your kind feedback, we truly appreciate your support!
Fast and great service!
Thank you for your generous 5-star rating!
Exceptional service! The staff are so friendly and very caring from start to finish. Very communicative via text and took great care of my precious Millie! Will definetly be back soon.

Took “Buddy” in for his  first spa experience and we were not disappointed. Buddy was shedding his winter undercoat and needed a shampoo badly. . . I opted for the deluxe treatment and Buddy came back to me looking sleek and smelling sweet! Woof Gang salon is in my neighborhood and I’m tickled to find a local business I can support and plan to make them a once a  month treat for my boy Buddy
Zoe groomed my miniature poodle, Kiki, beautifully. When we arrived home, ahe acted normal. Not traumatized. Yay!

Thank you for your generous 5-star rating! We are truly grateful for your support and are thrilled to hear that your experience was a positive one. Your feedback inspires us to continue serving others with dedication.

Great customer service!!! Great prices!! Their grooming salon staff are so accommodating! I just got my rescue dog from the San Marcos animal shelter and he's still anxious about being around strangers. I explained this to them and boy I was surprised! The groomer, she came out and clipped his dew claws and this made it so much better for my new doggy (Belgian Malinois)!!! I  highly recommend this place!!!
We love woofgang Broadway!!! Our first time and we will be back, they were quick and did amazing on the cut!
My pup loves her spa days at Wolfgang. The perfect grooming every time. She’s a delicate little flower. They take great care of her while she is there. Spoiled rotten.
absolutely love this place! so much more on the affordable side, amazing service & super cute shop too! definitely becoming a regular there
Great service and convenience

I love coming here.The staff  is always so amazing andkind they have a lot of goody treats for the fur babies and big dogs. I took my little princess there for her first pup groom and they did an amazing job. Thank v you woof gang
Wonderful staff, my cowboy is not the easiest to handle but these girls did great. He is nice and relaxed after his spa day.
Very close and convenient space to groom my cat. Very friendly staff, quick and quality job. Will be utilizing them more
Your support means a lot to us, and we're delighted to hear that you had a positive experience. Thank you and we can wait to see Mac soon!🩷🐾 …
Very professional. Took my puppy back immediately and was finished in under an hour. She even came out with a bow and nail polish.
Always a great time booking an appointment with Woof Gang Pearl! My doggie always gets great service and they are always communicative. Cute shop too!

I took my former shelter pooch, Toby, in for grooming. He tends to be a bit fearful, which I explained to them, but the employees were fantastic with him. He came out clean, relaxed, & happily wagging his tail! I highly recommend Woof Gang. 👍🏼🤩
My dog Griffin loves the selection of homemade treats. Sometimes I have to remind him that they aren’t open 24/7 because he knows to stop by their door on our walks.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are grateful to hear that your experience was a positive one.
All good great and friendly people Abel is great with my puppy
We absolutely love our Spa ! Everyone is so friendly and takes excellent care of our Pumpkin ! Thank you Vanessa and Zoe !

My pup loves going to Woof Gang!! Literally every groomer she’s gotten has left her looking fabulous and smelling even better. She now recognizes the store and can’t wait to get inside to be greeted by her friends. Lovely service! ✨🫶🏽✨ …
I love all the homemade snacks! Everything is always fresh, and their 50% off box is such a great selection.
Thank you for your generous 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are delighted to hear that your experience with us was a positive one.

I took my dachshund cocker spaniel mix boy to woodf gang. He’s been to a few different groomers & no one has given him a proper cut, until we came here. They did an absolutely amazing job! They took wonderful care of him & sent him home with treats. Highly recommend!
Very good
The service  10/10.
It was so wonderful, groomer was so careful and caring. Benjamin looks adorable and smells so nice. We choose the mini-grooming package
All my pups get the best cuts and grooming here.
Rosie was treated so well for her birthday 🌸💖🎂🥰 …
We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to hear that you had a great experience! 🐾🩷 …

I had been on the search for a regular groomer for my girl, but have only been to one other place to get my foster dogs to beauty-base-zero. The other groomers did a great job with the two dogs who needed to be groomed badly, but I'm thinking I just found my regular place for my sweet petite (the brown one). They had all three dogs in and out within a few hours, and they all smelled so good and their coats were silky soft! I'll definitely be back again!
